transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I wanted to get us together because the Northstar and Mosaic ERGs currently hold separate monthly forums, and their next two are scheduled for the same week. As we all know, attendance has declined at both forums since the groups began sharing several company-wide initiatives. I have the authority to approve a combined forum and temporary operating rules, but per my standard practice for changes affecting employee groups, I want to hold this roundtable with the group chairs, HR, and the executive sponsor before approving anything new. Let's discuss whether combining the forums makes sense and what temporary rules we'd need.
